beats.text: Pax and Polly stand squeezed together inside one hoodie, cheeks pressed together, gazing ahead with wide eyes
Pax and Polly close their eyes and blush while Pax wraps his flipper across the front of the hoodie

spans.view: with a display of tomatoes, striped squash and eggplants in front of him

beats.text: Pax stands behind the produce stand with a flipper resting on the vegetables, glancing from side to side
Pax picks a tomato from the display and holds it up close to his beak
Pax holds the tomato out at his side, smiling
Pax tosses the tomato up into the air above his head
Polly's flipper rises from behind Pax's head and catches the tomato while Pax waves and then closes his eyes
Pax and Polly turn sideways, stuck back to back by crumpled grey tape, as Polly holds the tomato over a basket
Polly drops the tomato into her basket as the taped pair shuffles left, Pax sliding toward the left edge

Polly lies on top of Pax with her eyes closed and blushing cheeks while Pax stays face down
